Bear.story: Gold Bear path; dollar strong, Fed keeps hiking, industrial demand slows and solar thrifting turns silver to surplus; GSR stays 85-90.

Base.story: Gold Base path; Fed pauses 2027, ratio mean-reverts toward 70 as the deficit resumes with electrification demand.

Bull.story: Gold Bull path; cuts and a weaker dollar, investment demand returns and deficits widen; GSR revisits the high 50s as in 2011 and early 2026.
